where: site records: Existing exact compressor/service/system and shared-header boundaries, current local/network/master narrative/settings/capability and source coverage, matched demand/pressure/load/power/time and storage/treatment records, base/trim roles, requirements and manufacturer/compatibility constraints.
DCS/PLC configuration: Review permitted existing compressor control settings/narratives with their coverage and active modes.

a walkdown: Only if applicable questions remain after existing-record review, agree safe additional observations with the responsible specialist; no mandatory live test, sampling, shutdown, tuning, instrument or equipment change.
data_requests.how: Two names or part-load scalar values do not show shared system or concurrent operation, and a global MASTER/SEQUENCER label does not cover every machine. S11 printed34-39/42 supports different local/network/master arrangements depending on equipment, requirements, demand/storage and complexity; part-loading of a suitable trim unit is not automatically waste. Known helper/nonair types are not air machines, but a compressor package is not omitted merely because its name mentions a dryer. Review suitable existing strategy and source/units/operating coverage before further work, consulting specialists for mixed/variable-speed arrangements. No automatic master addition, compressor stop or new logging is required.

questions.decision_rule: Review actual shared-system membership and concurrency, requirements, current local/network/master coordination, base/trim capabilities, demand/storage/pressure/power and source/time coverage with the responsible specialist. Multiple names or simultaneous part-load labels alone do not require sequencing hardware. Suitable existing strategy or nonapplicability can be acknowledged; unresolved scope/operation remains explicit without pressure/control or equipment-change authority.

questions.limits: IAC/ITAC figures are browse-page averages read through a summarizing fetch and not re-verified against the downloadable database; averages are skewed by outliers. Source review: S11 printed34-39/PDF39-44 and42/PDF47, full relevant control pages. Model-level at-least2 candidates is a records prompt, not inferred topology/concurrency or a claim the installed system lacks master control. Existing strategies and compatible operating requirements matter; source objective and IAC history are not site savings.
